entry.title: Streptococcal Infections XTRA 3D frequencies (Preset Variant 2)
entry.content:
Streptococcal Infections XTRA 3D frequencies (Preset Variant 2) is a curated acoustic research preset in the Brain Beats Pro 3D XTRA Frequency Presets archive (json/xtra-freq.json). This is XTRA 3D frequencies healing preset for Streptococcal Infections. The frequencies in this preset are: 150 hz, 700 hz, 2500 hz, 5250 hz, 47500 hz, 70000 hz, 369750 hz, 385400 hz, 842000 hz, 932000 hz

Section Use Case: Historical frequency cataloging, psychoacoustic classification, and educational indexing.

Its primary frequency component sits in the audible acoustic spectrum ($20\text{ Hz}\text{–}20\text{ kHz}$), directly perceived by the human auditory cortex as a clear harmonic tone.
  • Clinical Standards Verified via openFDA (Food and Drug Administration, USA): In accordance with evidence-based medicine, all pathophysiological, infectious, neurological, and inflammatory conditions referenced across complementary frequency catalogs are governed by validated pharmaceuticals evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), USA (Augmentin ES-600 (NDA 050755), Lexapro (NDA 021323), Zithromax (NDA 050733)):
    • Augmentin ES-600 (Amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium, USAntibiotics, LLC, FDA NDA 050755): beta-lactam / beta-lactamase inhibitor combination targeting beta-lactamase-producing respiratory, otic, sinus, cutaneous, and polymicrobial bacterial pathogens.
    • Lexapro (Escitalopram oxalate, Allergan, Inc., FDA NDA 021323): selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) indicated for major depressive disorder and generalized anxiety disorder.
    • Zithromax (Azithromycin dihydrate, Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc, FDA NDA 050733): macrolide 50S ribosomal subunit inhibitor for atypical respiratory pathogens (Legionella, Mycoplasma, Chlamydophila), Bartonella, and streptococcal pharyngitis.

4. Programmatic Web Audio API Reference

/**
 * PresetStreptococcalInfectionsXtra3DFrequenSynthesizer - Web Audio API DSP Reference
 * Mode: Audible de-octaved bank: [150.0, 700.0, 2500.0, 5250.0, 11875.0, 17500.0, 11554.6875, 12043.75]
 * Uses smooth exponential gain ramps and Nyquist clamping for distortion-free playback.
 */
class PresetStreptococcalInfectionsXtra3DFrequenSynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [150.0, 700.0, 2500.0, 5250.0, 11875.0, 17500.0, 11554.6875, 12043.75];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
        const safeVol = Math.max(0.005, volume / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length));
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(safeVol, now + 0.08);
        this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        this.frequencies.forEach((rawHz, idx) => {
            let hz = Number(rawHz) || 432;
            while (hz > 20000) hz /= 2;
            if (hz < 20) hz = 174 + hz;
            const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.min(hz, nyquist), now);
            const panner = this.ctx.createStereoPanner();
            const angle = (idx / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length)) * Math.PI * 2;
            panner.pan.setValueAtTime(Math.cos(angle) * 0.7, now);
            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

/**

 * Uses smooth exponential gain ramps and Nyquist clamping for distortion-free playback.
 */
class PresetLymphogranulomaMalignantXtra3DFrequeSynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [20.0, 120.0, 950.0, 13390.0, 11250.0, 12500.0, 15000.0, 11687.5];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
        const safeVol = Math.max(0.005, volume / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length));
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(safeVol, now + 0.08);

            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

class PresetArthritisRheumatoidXtra3DFrequenciesSynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [190.0, 1000.0, 2800.0, 17500.0, 12450.0, 14062.5, 15945.3125, 10656.5625];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
        const safeVol = Math.max(0.005, volume / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length));
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(safeVol, now + 0.08);

            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

/**
 * PresetAcneSkinXtra3DFrequenciesPresetVariaSynthesizer - Web Audio API DSP Reference
 * Mode: Audible de-octaved bank: [50.0, 370.0, 830.0, 2500.0, 3000.0, 18325.0, 11992.1875, 12093.75]
 * Uses smooth exponential gain ramps and Nyquist clamping for distortion-free playback.
 */
class PresetAcneSkinXtra3DFrequenciesPresetVariaSynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [50.0, 370.0, 830.0, 2500.0, 3000.0, 18325.0, 11992.1875, 12093.75];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
        const safeVol = Math.max(0.005, volume / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length));
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(safeVol, now + 0.08);
        this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        this.frequencies.forEach((rawHz, idx) => {
            let hz = Number(rawHz) || 432;
            while (hz > 20000) hz /= 2;
            if (hz < 20) hz = 174 + hz;
            const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.min(hz, nyquist), now);
            const panner = this.ctx.createStereoPanner();
            const angle = (idx / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length)) * Math.PI * 2;
            panner.pan.setValueAtTime(Math.cos(angle) * 0.7, now);
            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

/**
 * PresetSoundHealingResearchFoundationWebrinSynthesizer - Web Audio API DSP Reference
 * Mode: Audible de-octaved bank: [432.0]
 * Uses smooth exponential gain ramps and Nyquist clamping for distortion-free playback.
 */
class PresetSoundHealingResearchFoundationWebrinSynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [432.0];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
        const safeVol = Math.max(0.005, volume / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length));
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(safeVol, now + 0.08);
        this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        this.frequencies.forEach((rawHz, idx) => {
            let hz = Number(rawHz) || 432;
            while (hz > 20000) hz /= 2;
            if (hz < 20) hz = 174 + hz;
            const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.min(hz, nyquist), now);
            const panner = this.ctx.createStereoPanner();
            const angle = (idx / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length)) * Math.PI * 2;
            panner.pan.setValueAtTime(Math.cos(angle) * 0.7, now);
            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

4. Programmatic Web Audio API Reference

/**
 * PresetLunarsightWebringResourceSynthesizer - Web Audio API DSP Reference
 * Mode: Audible de-octaved bank: [432.0]
 * Uses smooth exponential gain ramps and Nyquist clamping for distortion-free playback.
 */
class PresetLunarsightWebringResourceSynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [432.0];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
        const safeVol = Math.max(0.005, volume / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length));
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(safeVol, now + 0.08);
        this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        this.frequencies.forEach((rawHz, idx) => {
            let hz = Number(rawHz) || 432;
            while (hz > 20000) hz /= 2;
            if (hz < 20) hz = 174 + hz;
            const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.min(hz, nyquist), now);
            const panner = this.ctx.createStereoPanner();
            const angle = (idx / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length)) * Math.PI * 2;
            panner.pan.setValueAtTime(Math.cos(angle) * 0.7, now);
            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

/**
 * PresetAudioterapiaWebringResourceSynthesizer - Web Audio API DSP Reference
 * Mode: Audible de-octaved bank: [432.0]
 * Uses smooth exponential gain ramps and Nyquist clamping for distortion-free playback.
 */
class PresetAudioterapiaWebringResourceSynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [432.0];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);

            while (hz > 20000) hz /= 2;

            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.min(hz, nyquist), now);

            const angle = (idx / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length)) * Math.PI * 2;

            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

/**
 * Preset1974HzSolfeggioFrequencySynthesizer - Web Audio API DSP Reference
 * Mode: Audible de-octaved bank: [1974.0]
 * Uses smooth exponential gain ramps and Nyquist clamping for distortion-free playback.
 */
class Preset1974HzSolfeggioFrequencySynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [1974.0];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
        const safeVol = Math.max(0.005, volume / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length));
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(safeVol, now + 0.08);
        this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        this.frequencies.forEach((rawHz, idx) => {
            let hz = Number(rawHz) || 432;
            while (hz > 20000) hz /= 2;
            if (hz < 20) hz = 174 + hz;
            const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.min(hz, nyquist), now);
            const panner = this.ctx.createStereoPanner();
            const angle = (idx / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length)) * Math.PI * 2;
            panner.pan.setValueAtTime(Math.cos(angle) * 0.7, now);
            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

/**

class Preset1518HzSolfeggioFrequencySynthesizer {
    constructor(audioCtx = null) {
        this.ctx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        this.frequencies = [1518.0];
        this.nodes = [];
        this.masterGain = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;
    }

    start(volume = 0.35) {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        const nyquist = this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.45;
        this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
        const safeVol = Math.max(0.005, volume / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length));

            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}

        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(safeVol, now + 0.08);
        this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        this.frequencies.forEach((rawHz, idx) => {
            let hz = Number(rawHz) || 432;
            while (hz > 20000) hz /= 2;
            if (hz < 20) hz = 174 + hz;
            const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.min(hz, nyquist), now);
            const panner = this.ctx.createStereoPanner();
            const angle = (idx / Math.max(1, this.frequencies.length)) * Math.PI * 2;
            panner.pan.setValueAtTime(Math.cos(angle) * 0.7, now);
            osc.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(this.masterGain);
            osc.start(now);
            this.nodes.push(osc);
        });
        this.isPlaying = true;
    }

    stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying || !this.masterGain) return;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
        this.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.max(0.001, this.masterGain.gain.value), now);
        this.masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.06);
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop(); n.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} });
            this.nodes = [];
            this.isPlaying = false;
        }, 75);
    }
}
